notes: The clause's one copula is placed on כֵּן as the predicative anchor (rule 20, which puts a construction-supplied frame on an adverbial anchor as readily as on a noun or preposition); the competing reading placing it on the fronted כְּ phrase under rule 49 is named in that unit's note.
The article on חוֹחִים is unrepresented (*among thorns*), while the article on בָּנוֹת takes the written *the* — the count is run word by word, not by position (rule 29).
